author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Is harness engineering just another bitter lesson?

I skipped over learning prompt engineering back in 2024, I was betting on AI will be smart be enough to understand me soon.

I skipped over building context engineering back in 2025, I just dump everything into markdown files, clean them up for AI to read, betting on AI will be smart enough to distill useful information from them automatically.

Should I wait and skip building harness engineering in 2026?   Will AI be smart enough to orchestrate itself in 2027?

comments.text: The slower I learn, the faster I learn.
